housing_subtitle: Orientation when looking for an apartment and tenancy law
find_housing_subtitle: How do I find apartments in Austria?
finding_preparation_ads_desc: Use apartment advertisements in newspapers and online platforms (e.g. Willhaben, WG-Gesucht, Facebook groups).
finding_preparation_budget_desc: The rent (including additional costs) should be a maximum of one third of your income.
finding_preparation_costs_desc: Please note additional costs such as deposit and possible broker commission.
finding_viewing_subtitle: What you should pay attention to
finding_viewing_appt_desc: Arrange viewing appointments in good time.
finding_viewing_check_desc: Pay attention to brightness, room layout and the condition of the apartment (windows, doors, heating).
finding_viewing_lift_desc: Check whether there is a lift (on higher floors).
finding_viewing_prep_desc: Prepare questions and show up on time and neatly.
registration_meldezettel_subtitle: The registration form is a form for registering your residential address.
registration_meldezettel_what_desc: A form for registering your residential address in Austria.
registration_meldezettel_how_desc: Fill out the form → Landlord signs → Submit to the municipal office or magistrate.
registration_meldezettel_deadline_desc: No later than 3 days after moving in.
cost_rent_desc: Monthly amount for the use of the apartment.
cost_deposit_desc: Security payment (usually 2-3 months’ rent).Will be paid back when you move out if the apartment is in good condition.
cost_utilities_desc: Additional costs such as operating costs, heating, electricity and internet.
contract_definition_desc: Contract between tenant and landlord.Regulates duration and costs.
contract_important_desc: Address, rent amount, deposit, contract duration, notice period.
contract_refund_desc: Right to refund of deposit (if no damage).
everyday_rules_house_desc: Please note the rest times and rules of the household.
everyday_garbage_split_desc: Dispose of paper, organic, plastic and residual waste separately.
everyday_utils_reg_desc: Electricity and Internet often have to be registered with the provider yourself.
